messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morales <dana.morales@acmehealth.com>, Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Health - security/compliance follow-up & VPC/on-prem options

Hi Dana / Oliver

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard from your side:
- You need a private deployment option (VPC or on-prem) for PHI workloads and a deployment diagram that shows network isolation and data flows.
- You have a vendor security questionnaire that you prefer we complete (SOC 2 evidence, encryption, logging, data retention).
- Procurement timeline: target vendor selection by mid-March, with security sign-off needed before purchase order.

Requested deliverables from Redwood (we can provide by the dates below):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (latest) attached (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf) delivery: today.
2) Private/VPC and on-prem deployment diagrams + short notes on air-gapped options, KMS integration (HSM supported), and network isolation patterns attached (redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram.png) delivery: tomorrow EOD.
3) Vendor security questionnaire we'll kick off via our SecureQ flow and share the invite; we can also take a walkthrough if helpful. I'll attach our standard SQ template for reference (vendor-security-questionnaire-template.pdf).
4) Mutual action plan with milestones and owners I'll attach a draft and propose dates for a follow-up call.

Proposed next steps:
- I will upload the SOC2 and diagram to the secure link and send the SecureQ invitation by EOD today.
- Naomi (cc'd, Redwood security lead) will join a 30-minute walkthrough to go over network diagrams and logging/retention questions.
- Can we schedule a follow-up for next week (Wed 3/3 or Thu 3/4 PST)? Please confirm availability.

If there are any additional compliance documents you need (HIPAA BAAs, GDPR DPA), call them out and we'll include.

Thanks looking forward to working through this.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram.png, vendor-security-questionnaire-template.pdf

From: Dana Morales <dana.morales@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health - security/compliance follow-up & VPC/on-prem options

Marcus

Thanks for the quick recap and for sending the SOC2. A few clarifications from our security team: 
- For the deployment diagram, can you include both VPC peering and private-link style options, and a separate slide that covers an air-gapped on-prem deployment (how model updates would be delivered)?
- Our procurement team needs to know whether SSO (SAML/Okta) and audit log retention (we require 1 year) are supported in the private deployment.
- We'll start the vendor questionnaire but want to confirm the timeframe: can you commit to returning the completed SQ within 7 business days after we send it?

Also looping in our security lead, Oliver (cc), who will own the questionnaire from our side. Oliver would you like to join the walkthrough Naomi proposed?

Thanks,
Dana
Sr. IT Security Manager | Acme Health
Dana.Morales@acmehealth.com

- Diagrams: we'll include both VPC peering and PrivateLink-style architectures plus a separate air-gapped on-prem deployment note that details how model and code updates are provisioned (offline bundle and signed artifacts). Expect the diagram deck by EOD tomorrow.
- SSO & Audit logs: yes SAML/OIDC (Okta) is supported in Private and Dedicated modes. Audit logs can be configured for a 1-year retention in your private deployment; we will outline the log storage options and retention controls in the deck.
- Vendor SQ turnaround: we will prioritize the questionnaire and aim to return within 5 business days after you send it. If any sections require engineering input, Naomi will own those.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan_ACME-2374.pdf (draft MAP) this contains proposed milestones (docs delivery, SQ start/completion, security walkthrough, procurement sign-off).

Naomi can you join a 30-min walkthrough on Wed 3/3 at 10:00 AM PST? If that doesn't work, propose an alternate.

Dana / Oliver I'll send the SecureQ invite now and upload the docs to the HubSpot deal link so procurement has access.

Best,
Marcus
